STAFF REPORT — Meeting of January 15, 2024

Subject: Approval of Amended Services Agreement with Axon Enterprise Inc.
         for Body-Worn Camera Program

Recommended Action: Approve the Amendment No. 2 to the Services Agreement
with Axon Enterprise Inc., increasing the total contract authorization
from $250,000 to $1,250,000 over the original three-year term, with
automatic annual renewal.

Background: In 2022 the City entered into a sole-source agreement with
Axon Enterprise Inc. for body-worn camera hardware and cloud evidence
storage. The original authorization was $250,000. Staff now requests
an increase of $1,000,000 to extend device coverage to all sworn
personnel and to add the Axon Fleet dashcam integration.

Fiscal Impact: The $1,000,000 increase will be funded through the FY24
General Fund and a pending JAG grant award.
